      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a bug where invalidateblock silently returned success despite a failure disconnecting blocks that left the chain partially rolled back. Because invalidateblock is primarily an administrative and testing tool rather than a standard hot method, the impact on everyday RPC callers is limited."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes Chainstate::InvalidateBlock error state propagation in src/validation.cpp and adds blockchain unit tests for disconnect failures.",

      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Surfaces block disconnection failures in Chainstate::InvalidateBlock by populating BlockValidationState instead of silently ignoring them. The change improves internal state accounting during rollbacks without modifying consensus rules or core validation algorithms."
